name: Hearts and Hands Food Pantry (Axe Memorial UMC)
hoursNotes: Shower facilities for homeless individuals available Thursdays 9am–12pm.
requirements: Picture ID, proof of residence in 75041 (utility bill or rent receipt), and documentation of income sources. Food assistance every 60 days; about 5 days of food based on family size. Other ZIP codes served one time when possible.
notes: Primary focus is the 75041 ZIP code; also provides referrals to other Garland/Dallas County agencies.
